newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy watchdog refers Fidis trading case to courts.
newsitem.headline: Italy watchdog refers Fidis trading case to courts.

text.p: Italian bourse watchdog Consob said it decided to refer a case of suspected insider trading on shares in Fiat SpA group financial services company Fidis to Milan magistrates for possible investigation.
Consob said in a statement the case referred to trading of Fidis shares before January 31, 1996, the day on which Fiat's board announced it decided to incorporate Fidis.
The merger operation was preceded by a public offer to buy Fidis shares equal to 48.23 percent of its share capital.
Under Italian law, Consob must send its findings to magistrates and the magistrates then decide whether or not to pursue the investigation.
